searchText: Call in 1 hour 20 minutes. Considering this the "implementers kick-off call". call in 3 minutes: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82318873396?pwd=K0hoeFhkRk9OWHFJeXl5S1RnanBoQT09 <@!420951281910284289> Full is opposed to partial -- i.e. it means there is not just a reduction of active state (partial stateless does that), but providing witnesses for everything it is not opposed to weak -- weak statelessness means that validating the chain is possible without any state access, but proposing needs the state Weak statelessness has the advantage that it gives us much more freedom in witness construction. Having to construction block witnesses from transaction witnesses excludes some of the most efficient witness accumulation schemes it also means having to think about things like DSA, which are simply not a problem with weak statelessness https://github.com/ethereum/stateless-ethereum-specs/pull/54 Please fill out this doodle. Call is being rescheduled, chime in with what works for you: https://doodle.com/poll/zg3wkciag7tcxdgh?utm_source=poll&utm_medium=link <@!364458974906548225> when there is a time set, can you LMK and I'll add it to the calendar we have with all the protocol calls?
